body:
Current `data/ingredients/unmapped/3-methylacetate.yaml` (SHA256 `98d0af6ac0a86e2ae354ffeb39933840658bfec5550a0b2e81a1f59246eb604a`) actively describes the label as an importer fragment and suggests `3-methyl mercaptopropionate` as its likely original. The source evidence supports neither assertion.

The current KG-Microbe input `data/raw/database.csv` has SHA256 `0c6ff730a108720a5d6972400f2bccf2eca8621713b62736abdf5df0fb188c95`. Its exact record19685 identifies Telmatobacter bradus, LPSN789679, with:

- `Bergey_Text_for_end_products`: “acetate and hydrogen, plus traces of 2-methylbutyrate and 3-methylacetate”
- `Bergey_Minor_end_products`: `2-methylbutyrate;3-methylacetate`
- Original citation: https://doi.org/10.1002/9781118960608.gbm01426

The canonical source-record hash is `f96206bc73f8fa93d7a144e6f4f586e8e464d23b31d8093a0d510bc5d272302a`; the exact CSV header/row extract has SHA256 `b60fee13501d1ddba9d53688462f86055a9c1d6c6a470157e336a00ca93e7360`. The source-bound material catalogue in [KG-Microbe PR1220](https://github.com/Knowledge-Graph-Hub/kg-microbe/pull/1220) already records this as `unresolved_product_identity`, preserving the source `produces` assertion and refusing an inferred replacement.

This does not establish a chemical identity or a growth-medium ingredient. It does establish that the literal is present before MIM ingestion, including in source prose. The original primary publication has not been independently re-read in this bounded provenance check; no alternative substance is proposed.

Prior decisions: [#213's residual comment](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/213#issuecomment-5202847885) listed this among parse fragments. #308 addresses a real comma/locant corruption mechanism, but its current body and comment do not establish that mechanism for this exact record. Retain those historical statements as historical evidence; correct the current active explanation without rewriting them.

Proposed narrow fix: replace only the active `notes` with the exact source-provenance observation, expressly withdraw the unsupported fragment/mercaptopropionate explanation, retain the unresolved identity and existing no-export boundary, and append an honest curation event through the guarded writer. Preserve the preferred label, placeholder, REJECTED status, raw synonym, all earlier history and occurrence counts. Do not invent a CAS, ontology identity, replacement synonym, role or ingredient classification. A later status/product-scope decision remains separate.

Acceptance: current source-record hash and raw wording checked; individual/aggregate copies synchronized; all old history bytes preserved; no new SSSOM or semantic claim; native QC and focused regression prove only notes/history changed. Whole-corpus provenance manifests must be refreshed because owner bytes changed. Current canonical SSSOM and paired companion review contain no mapping or claim for this owner; whole-corpus `record_inputs` and publication-manifest owner hashes do bind it.
title: Correct the unsupported importer-fragment explanation for literal MicrobeDecoder 3-methylacetate
